column1: # MANT-INV08 (9 Oct 2026, LANE FAMILY-A2f account 2): Loc. 694/08 stride-4 inventory of the 376 frames no earlier TSV or NOTES section lists (94 frames, every fourth in file order from 0002) + controls. www.archiv.sachsen.de frames.tsv URLs, 100 requests (94 + 6 controls), >=1.6 s apart, all HTTP 200 image/jpeg. 14 contact sheets of 8-9 (800 px tiles, film header cropped, shuffled seed 608, one known-cipher and one known-clear control per sheet), 4 Sonnet calls; every non-none target eye-checked by the worker at 1500 px. Frame ids are URL file numbers (film stamp = file+1). Grade M; gloss words in notes are the worker eye reading at 1500 px (M), not transcriptions.
